question: Up to what limit may the measure be increased from its own base?
premises: Increase is made in fractional parts
The base is its own placement
inference: The measure may be increased by fractional parts up to twice its own base.
uncertainties: The exact fractional increment implied by aṣṭāṃśādaṃśa is unclear.
plain_english: It may be increased by parts from its own base up to a limit of twice that measure.
